label: 5. After running on the surface that one time,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: After running on the surface that one time,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I've never been able to forget it.

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: I want to run freely on the surface again.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: We'll be with lots of passengers!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: But you don't need to be too downhearted.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I'm sure you'll make that day come,

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: right, Commander?
Of course.
Just wait a little longer.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I'm sure it won't be long now, hehe.

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Next time we're on the surface,

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: I'm gonna explore the place properly. Hehehehe!

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I feel the same.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I got to truly experience

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: how hot the desert sun can be.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: It stung a little,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: but feeling the real sunlight was quite pleasant.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I want to go to the snowy mountains again.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I loved how the snow

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: crunched under my feet.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: It just felt so nice!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Even though it was freezing, it somehow felt kind of cozy.

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Heck yeah!

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Next time,

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: I'm gonna explore every single one! No way I'm missing a thing!
For a brief moment, no messages come through.

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Nora said it herself, remember?

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Survive, keep our journey going,

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: and show everyone the amazing views we've seen.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: For that day,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: we'll need to work harder than we do now.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: After all, we're responsible for our passengers' travel and safety!

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: That's not all!

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Everyone on our train

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: has to be happy and have a blast!

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: After all, the AZX brings happiness wherever it goes!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: You're right, hehehe!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I just thought of something!

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: What if we put a bag of strawberry candy on every seat?

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: I bet everyone would feel happy every time they take one, teehee!
How about we start by coming up with another idea?

lines.speaker: soline_w
lines.text: Candy's nice and all, but let's think a bit differently, okay? Hehehe. Like switching to more comfortable seats or something! I mean, there's plenty we could do!

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: We should take a more practical approach.

lines.speaker: diesel_w
lines.text: But I think strawberry candy is a good idea too T_T
